question: India cuts off water flow to Pakistan from Baglihar Dam in the wake of Pahalgam terror attack. On which river is the Baglihar Dam located?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Chenab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India cuts off water flow to Pakistan from Baglihar Dam in the wake of Pahalgam terror attack.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
India has cut off water flow to Pakistan via **Baglihar Dam** on the **Chenab River**.

 
 
• 
 
The decision follows the **Pahalgam terror attack** on **April 22**, in which **26 civilians** were killed.

 
 
• 
 
India has decided not to allow a **“single drop”** of water from the Indus rivers to go to Pakistan.

 
 
• 
 
The action marks a **suspension of the Indus Waters Treaty (IWT)**, which dates back to **1960** and was brokered by the **World Bank**.

 
 
• 
 
India is also considering similar restrictions at the **Kishanganga Dam** on the **Jhelum River**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Baglihar Dam** and **Kishanganga Dam** have both been subjects of past **legal and diplomatic disputes** between India and Pakistan.

 
 
• 
 
The **Neelum River**, a tributary of the Jhelum, is impacted by the Kishanganga project.

 
 
• 
 
These hydroelectric projects allow India to **regulate the timing of water releases**, adding strategic value in water diplomacy.
